title: You Connected Everything. That Is Why It Got Worse.
description:
Your AI agent got slower and started reaching for the wrong tool the moment you connected everything, because tool definitions are text sitting at the front of every single request. One vendor publishes the point where its own model starts to degrade, and the number is smaller than it sounds. From Put AI to Work episode two: tool design.

Full episode: https://youtu.be/u9Iyzoa37nk
